scope: Only current workspace files; no network; inputs unchanged

recommendation.reject: Blanket mobile shutdown and automatic desktop budget transfer
recommendation.execution_gate: Confirm conversion maturity, attribution completeness and spend before pause; otherwise stop expansion and cap diagnostic spend
recommendation.budget: Hold released budget; test incremental search capacity with a fixed spend/loss cap before scaling

decomposition.method: Old rates for composition effect, new weights for within-segment effect

limitations: No profit or lead quality data
Confidence interval assumes independent visits and mature conversions
unavailable_sources: Conversion delay distribution and server logs
Release, promotion and external demand calendar
Alternative landing experiment within the same segment
Incremental search capacity and marginal CPA

next_steps.action: Validate maturity, tracking and spend; review within one business day
Inspect offer form, speed and server acceptance on iOS
After validation, apply narrow reversible pause; preserve mobile search; avoid automatic desktop transfer
Design randomized landing comparison within segment, with useful effect, sample size, conversion window and loss cap specified before launch

reconsider_when.narrow_pause: Mature conversions change CPA; profitable lead quality; bad partner placements localized
reconsider_when.resume_scaling: Mature comparable test supports CPA <= 1000 RUB with uncertainty and lead quality assessed
reconsider_when.broad_mobile_pause: Validated threshold violations in other material mobile segments or a common technical failure
reconsider_when.budget_transfer: Incremental test supports extra accepted leads at marginal CPA <= 1000 RUB
